correctness.rationale: Every algebra automorphism is parametrized by (A,u)∈GL₂(q)×(F_q²)* with φ(v)=Av+u(v)z, φ(z)=det(A)z. Radical fixed points solve (A−I)v=0 and u(v)+(det A−1)t=0; the whole fixed space gains scalar line 1. Split determinant!=1 (a 1-eigenvector iff conjugate diag(1,det A)), A=I, nonidentity unipotent det1, and remaining SL₂(q) with no 1-eigenvectors; all disjoint and exhaustive. Counts yield N1=q³(q+1)(q−2)², N2=2q⁵−q⁴−4q³−q²+q, N3=(q+1)(q²−1), N4=1, summing q²|GL₂(q)|. Radical orbits: zero, nonzero socle, nonzero linear part; independently enumerated every (A,u) for q=3 and q=5, yielding {1:108,2:291,3:32,4:1} and {1:6750,2:5105,3:144,4:1}, verifying formulas and Burnside 3q. Field-independence of counts proves extension fields, not prime-only finite checks.
